headline: DSK Legal, AMR Law, CAM, SAM act on GreatWhite Electricals change in ownership
sum: Hemang Jadavji Shah and certain other sellers have sold off their entire shareholding, representing 50% of the issued and paid-up share capital, in Great White Global Private Limited, to Mehul Jadavji Shah and an alternate investment fund.…
detail: Hemang Jadavji Shah and certain other sellers have sold off their entire shareholding, representing 50% of the issued and paid-up share capital, in Great White Global Private Limited, to Mehul Jadavji Shah and an alternate investment fund. The transaction involved resolving a longstanding shareholder dispute between Hemang Jadavji Shah and Mehul Jadavji Shah, who each held a 50% stake in the Company. The dispute was the subject of proceedings before the National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench.
